currentPassword.description: Existing password, which must match before the password can be changed.

identifier.description: Email or username of the account to reset, matched the same way as sign in.

PasswordResetRequest.description: Asks for a password reset link. The answer is the same whether or not an account matches.

token.description: The one-time token from the reset link. It works once and expires 10 minutes after it was sent.

newPassword.description: The new password for the account.

confirmNewPassword.description: Repeat of the new password to guard against typing mistakes.

PasswordResetConfirmRequest.description: Sets a new password with a reset link. Every session of the account is signed out.

leagueCode.description: Exact league code confirmation required before permanently deleting an inactive league.

name.description: Updated primary league name shown in selectors, tiles, and league home.

description.description: Optional updated commissioner-facing league description. Omit or send an empty value to clear it.

iconKey.description: Built-in league icon from the curated PoolMaster icon catalog. Send the current icon to keep it.

UpdateLeagueDetailsRequest.description: Commissioner request payload for editing league details while the league remains active. Name, description and icon are replaced together, so a save either applies all three or none.

cupName.description: The league championship's name, shown after its year.

cupPointsScale.description: The points table every cup and the championship score on.

cupCustomPoints.description: CUSTOM's whole points for 1st, 2nd ... (0 to 1000, at most 50 places). Required, and only allowed, for CUSTOM: 400 CUP_CUSTOM_POINTS_INVALID otherwise. Send [] for every other scale.

UpdateLeagueCupSettingsRequest.description: Commissioner request payload for the league's championship settings: its name and points table, replaced together. Cups score on read, so they follow a new table at once; the championship keeps the points each contest earned when it went final, and scores later contests on the new table.

emails.description: Email recipients to invite into the league.

message.description: Optional commissioner note included with the invitation email.

SendLeagueInvitationsRequest.description: Commissioner request payload for sending direct email invites.

maxUses.description: Optional maximum number of accepted joins. Zero means unlimited use.

role.description: Target membership role after the change. Commissioner grants league-administration access.

inviteCode.description: Invite code from the invite URL or invitation email.

EmailMessageStatus.description: Where one email stands: QUEUED waiting to be sent, SENDING being sent, SENT accepted by the mail service, DELIVERED reached the recipient's mail server, BOUNCED refused for good by that server, COMPLAINED marked as spam by the recipient, FAILED not sent after every try or rejected by the mail service, SKIPPED not sent (see the skip reason).

EmailSkipReason.description: Why an email was not sent: EMAIL_DISABLED email is switched off, TEMPLATE_DISABLED this kind of email is switched off, NOT_ALLOWED_IN_ENVIRONMENT the address may not be emailed here, SUPPRESSED the address bounced for good or marked an earlier email as spam.

email.description: Email recipient for direct email invites. Link invites omit this field.

inviteCode.description: Shareable invitation code used in URLs and acceptance requests.

inviteType.description: Invitation delivery mode, such as EMAIL or LINK.

status.description: Invitation lifecycle state, such as PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVOKED, or EXPIRED.

maxUses.description: Maximum accepted joins allowed for the invitation.

currentUses.description: How many times the invitation has already been accepted.

invitedBy.description: User ID of the commissioner or actor that issued the invite.

expiresAt.description: When the invite stops being valid, if it expires.

acceptedAt.description: When the invitation was accepted, if applicable.

acceptedBy.description: User ID that accepted the invite, when known.

emailStatus.description: Where the latest email of an email invite stands; null for a join link, which has no email.

emailSkipReason.description: Why the latest email of an email invite was not sent; null unless emailStatus is SKIPPED.

createdAt.description: Invitation creation timestamp.

updatedAt.description: Last invitation update timestamp.

countedScores.description: How many golfer scores count toward the entry total, best first. At most the roster size.

tiersUsed.description: How many of the event's tiers an entry picks from, the first ones in tier order (tennis's "Seeds only": the first four). Left out, every tier. The event owns its tiers (#249), so this is the contest's rule, not a second tier layout.

maxEntriesPerSquad.description: Maximum entries a Team may create. Null means unlimited.

pointsTable.description: Points by finishing place: the first value is what the winner scores, the second second place, and so on, at most 50 places. Never increasing. A place beyond the table scores 0. Win / Place / Show is [5, 3, 1].

didNotFinishPoints.description: What a runner scores when it did not finish, was disqualified or did not start (including one scratched after picks closed). Usually 0.

config.description: Finish-position points settings: the contest's points table and its "did not finish" value.

roundValues.description: Points for a win in each round, round 1 first, one value per round of the event (at most 8). Doubling for a six-round bracket is [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32].

multiplier.description: What each seed of difference is worth. 1 is the usual rule; 2 doubles the bonus.

upsetBonus.description: The upset bonus: none, or the seed difference times a multiplier when a worse seed (a higher number) beats a better one. No bonus for equal seeds or when the better seed wins. An unseeded team counts as the field's worst seed.

config.description: Knockout round-points settings: the value of a win in each round and the upset bonus.

scoring.description: The contest's scoring definition and its settings (a finish-position contest's points table). Omitted on create, the template's preset applies, else the sport's default definition with its default settings; a definition whose settings have no default (finish-position points) must then be sent. Omitted on a rules change, the contest keeps its scoring.

anyOf.description: Tiered rules: pick the same number of golfers from every tier of the event, or from its first tiersUsed tiers.

rosterSize.description: How many golfers an entry picks, from anywhere in the field.

bracketAdvancement.description: How the sport league's bracket winners reach their next match: FIXED by each match's link, or RESEED_BY_SEED, where after a round whose matches link nowhere the admin places the teams left in each region, the best seed hosting the worst (the NFL). roundNames.description: What the sport league calls its bracket's rounds, first to final (the NBA: First Round, Conference Semifinals, Conference Finals, NBA Finals). Empty when the sport's round names are used. Set with the league's reference data, never by a request.

matchPeriodLayout.description: The periods the sport league's games are played in, when not its sport's: HALVES for men's college basketball. Null plays the sport's layout. Set with the league's reference data, never by a request.

squaresFromRound.description: The first round whose matches are single games a squares contest can be played on, when not every round's are: 5 for the Champions League, whose earlier rounds are two-legged ties, 3 for MLS, whose round one is a best-of-three series. Null when every round's matches can take one. Set with the league's reference data, never by a request.

externalId.description: Provider-side event identifier used by sync operations. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

providerId.description: Provider that emitted the event, or manual-admin for an admin-authored one. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

name.description: Event name shown in contest and event selectors.

venue.description: Venue name when known; null otherwise.

location.description: Human-readable location when known; null otherwise.

status.description: Event lifecycle status.

endDate.description: Scheduled or actual end time when known; null otherwise.

rounds.description: Number of rounds when the format has them; null otherwise.

roundsPar.description: Par for every round, when an admin set it. Null: contest scoring derives each round's par from the field's finished rounds. Contest scoring uses it to turn an unplayed round's 80 strokes into to-par.

participantCount.description: Field size the provider reports, when it reports one; null otherwise.

loadedParticipantCount.description: Number of event participants currently persisted for the event.

untieredParticipantCount.description: Active event participants with no tier. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

unpricedParticipantCount.description: Active event participants with no price. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

salaryCap.description: Whole dollars. The salary cap the prices are a share of, and the cap of every budget contest on the event.

unit.description: Whole dollars. Every price is rounded to a multiple of it. At most the worst golfer's price.

topSharePercent.description: The best seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap.

floorSharePercent.description: The worst seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap. At most `topSharePercent`.

steepness.description: How fast prices fall from the top: 1 is a straight line; higher keeps the top few expensive and drops the middle of the field towards the floor.

profileName.description: The profile the values started from. The admin may have changed any value before assigning.

pricing.description: The values the field was last priced with for budget contests, or null until prices are assigned. Locked at release; its salaryCap is the cap of every budget contest on the event.

readinessReasons.description: Why the event is or is not contest-eligible right now: not released yet (DRAFT), no field loaded, or already started.

contestEligible.description: Whether a contest can be created on the event right now: it is released, its field is loaded, and it has not started.

eventSeriesId.description: The recurring tournament (event series) this is one edition of — the event's only parent.

eventYear.description: The year this edition is branded with ("the 2026 Masters"), which is not always the year startDate falls in. One edition of a series per year.

sportLeagueId.description: The sport league the event's series belongs to. Read through the series, not stored on the event.

syncScope.description: How much provider data this event accepts on sync. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

autoLifecycleEnabled.description: Whether the lifecycle scheduler may move this event's status. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

tierCount.description: Pick tiers defined for the event. A tiered contest's entry picks this many tiers times the contest's picksPerTier.

emptyTierLabels.description: Labels of the event's tiers no active participant is in, in tier order. A DRAFT event can't be released while any remain: no entry could pick from them. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

contestCount.description: Contests run on the event, across every league; an event with any cannot be deleted. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

allowedTransitions.description: Statuses the event may move to next, from the declared transition map. (Admin-only: operational detail no member surface reads.)

createdAt.description: When the event row was created.

updatedAt.description: When the event row was last updated.

countedScores.description: How many golfer scores count toward the entry total, best first. At most the roster size.

confidence.description: A confidence pool's value for this pick, 1 to the week's number of games. Omitted or null in a straight-up pool, and until the entry gives one. A value may repeat until the week is submitted.

items.description: One game's pick as it is saved.

picks.description: The picks to save, one per game; may be empty when only the tiebreaker changes. Each replaces the entry's pick on that game; the entry's other picks are kept, except that in a bracket a later pick that no longer follows from the entry's picks is cleared, and in a survivor pool, which takes one pick, the entry's pick on another game is cleared. Saved together or not at all, so two confidence values can be swapped, or a whole bracket filled, in one request.

tiebreakerValue.description: The event's tiebreaker: the total points the entry expects in its tiebreaker game (`tiebreakerMatchId`: a bracket's final, a pick'em week's last game), both teams together. weekNumber.description: 1 for the contest's first week, by start date.

roundNumber.description: The round of the event the week is (#785): 1 for a regular-season week, which is an event of one round; each round of a playoff bracket is a week of its own.

roundCount.description: The event's number of rounds, for the round's name: 1 for a regular-season week.

name.description: The event's name; a playoff round is named by its round number and the event's round names.

started.description: Whether the week's first game has kicked off: an entry not submitted by then is out.

aliveCount.description: How many entries are still in after the week: those that survived it and those whose game is still to finish. 0 until it starts, and for a cancelled week.

items.description: One week of a survivor contest: a regular-season week, or one round of a playoff bracket.

weeks.description: The contest's weeks in week order.

alive.description: Whether the entry is still in.

eliminatedInWeek.description: The week number that put the entry out; null while it is in.

weeksSurvived.description: The weeks the entry survived: its score.

position.description: The entry's place: entries still in first, then by weeks survived. Entries out in the same week share a place, as do entries still in at the end.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

roundNumber.description: The round of the event the week is, as on the contest's weeks.

outcome.description: SURVIVED when the picked team won or its game was cancelled, ELIMINATED after a loss, a tie or a week not submitted by its first kickoff, PENDING while the game is unplayed. Null before the week starts, for a cancelled week, and for weeks after the entry went out.

team.description: The team the entry picked, once its game has kicked off. Null before then, and with no pick.

items.description: One entry's week of a survivor contest.

weeks.description: The entry's result for each of the contest's weeks, in week order.

items.description: One entry's standing in a survivor contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted at least one week, best first.

againstTheSpread.description: Whether picks are scored against each game's spread.

started.description: Whether the week's first game has kicked off: until then no entry has points for it.

settled.description: Whether the week has settled: its points and places are frozen, and a later result correction changes nothing. A cancelled week, or a completed week no entry submitted, is settled with nothing frozen.

gameCount.description: The week's games, cancelled ones left out. None when the week was cancelled.

tiebreakerTotalPoints.description: The week's last game's combined score once it is played: what the week's tiebreakers are measured against.

winnerEntryIds.description: The week's winners, the entries in first place once the week has settled; more than one when they are still level after the tiebreaker. Empty until it settles.

items.description: One week of a pick'em contest.

weeks.description: The contest's weeks in its week order.

position.description: The entry's place in the season, by total points. Entries level share a place. Null until a week the entry submitted has started.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

totalPoints.description: The season total so far: the sum of the entry's points over the weeks that have started.

submitted.description: Whether the entry submitted the week. A week still in draft at its first kickoff scores nothing.

points.description: The entry's points for the week: 1 for each correct pick straight up, the pick's confidence value in a confidence pool. Null until the week starts, and for a week it did not submit or that was cancelled.

position.description: The entry's place in the week: by points, then, once the week's last game is played, by how close its tiebreaker was to that game's total points. Null where points is.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

weeklyWinner.description: Whether the entry won the week: first place once the week has settled.

items.description: One entry's result for one week of a pick'em contest.

weeks.description: The entry's result for each of the contest's weeks, in the contest's week order.

items.description: One entry's standing in a pick'em contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted at least one week, best first.

eventCancelled.description: The event was cancelled: it counts for nothing, so every entry stands unscored and no game counts.

gameCount.description: The bracket's games: an entry picks each one. None when the event was cancelled.

finalTotalPoints.description: The final's combined score, both teams together, once it is played: what the tiebreakers are measured against.

position.description: The entry's place: by points, then, once the final is played, by how close its tiebreaker was to the final's total points. Entries still level share a place.

displayPosition.description: The place as shown, "T2" when shared.

points.description: Points so far: each correct pick's round value plus any upset bonus.

maxPossiblePoints.description: Points so far plus the round value of every pick whose team is still in: the most the entry can still reach.

tiebreakerValue.description: The entry's guess of the final's total points.

items.description: One entry's standing in a bracket contest.

entries.description: The entries that submitted their bracket, best first. An entry still in draft when the event started is left out.

mode.description: A pick'em pool's mode; null in a bracket or survivor pool.

againstTheSpread.description: Whether picks are scored against each game's spread: a pick names the team that covers. Only a pick'em pool can be.

tiePicksOffered.description: Whether a pick may say the game ends level (#792): a pick'em pool in a sport that offers tie picks, a draw in soccer. False in a bracket or survivor pool.

eliminatedInWeek.description: The week number (1 for the contest's first week) that put the entry out: a loss, a tie, or a week not submitted by its first kickoff. Null while it is still in. An entry that is out picks no later week.

usedParticipantIds.description: The teams, by participant id, the entry picked in its other submitted weeks: it cannot pick them again. Null on another team's entry, as they could show picks not yet revealed.

survivor.description: A survivor pool's season for the entry; null in the other pools.

status.description: The entry's status for this event: DRAFT while picking, SUBMITTED once every game is picked and submitted. Only a submitted event counts.

ownEntry.description: Whether the caller is on the entry's team, and so sees every pick on it.

canSubmit.description: Whether the caller can submit the event now: their own draft entry, every game picked with valid confidence values and the tiebreaker given, before the first game starts.

pickedCount.description: How many of the games have a pick. Counted on the caller's own entry; on another team's, only revealed games are counted.

tiebreakerMatchId.description: The game whose total points the tiebreaker guesses: a bracket's final, a pick'em week's last game by kickoff. Null while there is none.

tiebreakerValue.description: The entry's tiebreaker for the event, the tiebreaker game's total points. Null when not given, and on another team's entry until that game's picks are revealed.

points.description: Points so far: a bracket's round values and upset bonuses, a pick'em pick's 1 point, or its confidence value, for each correct pick. Null on another team's entry until all its picks are revealed.

maxPossiblePoints.description: Points so far plus what every pick still pending is worth: the most the entry can still reach. Null where points is.

kickoff.description: When the game starts: its scheduled time, else its event's start. Its pick locks then.

regionLabel.description: The bracket region or conference the game is in ("East", "AFC"), for grouping on screen; null where the bracket has none.

homeSpread.description: The points spread from the home team's side (#720): -3.5 has the home team favoured by 3.5. Null until set.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

home.description: The team really playing on this side; null until it is decided.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

away.description: The team really playing on this side; null until it is decided.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

predictedHome.description: The team the entry's own picks put on this side, which its pick chooses between: in a bracket, the team it picked to win the game feeding this side (in a reseeded round, its picked winners paired by seed); otherwise the real team. Null until the picks that decide it are made. On another team's entry, the real team until the game is revealed.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team's field row in the event: what a pick names.

predictedAway.description: As predictedHome, for the away side.

locked.description: Whether the game's pick can no longer change: it has kicked off, or the contest no longer takes picks.

revealed.description: Whether picks on this game are shown to the whole league: from its kickoff once the contest is live.

predictedResult.description: What the pick says happens: TEAM, its team wins; TIE, the game ends level (#792).

sportEventParticipantId.description: The team picked to win; null for a TIE pick.

confidence.description: The pick's confidence value; null in a straight-up pool, in a bracket, or until given.

outcome.description: How the pick stands against the results: CORRECT once its team won the game (in a bracket, its round; against the spread, covered), or for a TIE pick once the game ended level, BUSTED once it can no longer come true (a loss, a tie, a failure to cover, or in a bracket its team out), PUSH against the spread when the game landed exactly on it, else PENDING.

points.description: What the pick earned when CORRECT: in a bracket its round's value plus any upset bonus, in a pick'em pool 1 point straight up or its confidence value. 0 when BUSTED or PUSH, null while PENDING or not scored.

pick.description: The entry's pick on the game. Null when it has none, and on another team's entry until the game is revealed.

items.description: One game of the event with the entry's pick on it.

games.description: The event's games in game-number order. Cancelled games are left out: they are not picked.

standingsBufferMinutes.description: How many minutes after a round, week or event finishes its live standings email goes (#877), so a late score correction lands first.

templates.description: Per-template switches. A template that is off is skipped even while email is on.

resolution.description: How an uploaded row resolved to a participant: one match, none, or several.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The field row it resolved to; set only when MATCHED.

change.description: What applying the row would do to the golfer's stored round. SKIPPED: the row has no strokes, so applying stores nothing for it.

before.description: What is stored now; null when nothing is.

after.description: What is stored now; null when nothing is.

items.description: What applying one uploaded row would do.

rows.description: One per uploaded row, in upload order.

GolfRoundScorePreviewResponse.description: A dry run of a golf score upload. Nothing is written.

thru.description: Holes completed in the round. A round is 18 holes; playoff holes are never scored. Null clears it, for a golfer who has not started.

UpdateGolfRoundScoreRequest.description: A correction to one golfer's round. Each value sent is stored exactly as sent and nothing is derived from another: to par is not computed from strokes, and completedAt is not set by a COMPLETED status. Omitted values keep what is stored.

isOfficial.description: Whether the race's result is official once applied. It is set on every result of the race, sent or already stored: a race is official as a whole. Contest scoring counts results only once they are official.

resultStatus.description: How the race ended for this runner.

finishPosition.description: Finishing place, 1 for the winner. Runners in a dead heat share a place, and the next place skips (1, 2, 2, 4). Only a FINISHED runner has one; it is required for every FINISHED runner once the result is official.

startPosition.description: Post position (or grid slot); null when not known.

riderName.description: The jockey (or rider) for this start; null when not known.

items.description: One runner's result. The first identifier present is used: participantId, then externalId, then an exact case-insensitive playerName, matched within the event's field. Every value is stored exactly as sent.

RaceResultUploadRequest.description: A race's finishing order, or a correction to it: one row per runner named. Runners not named keep the result already stored.

resultStatus.description: How the race ended for this runner.

finishPosition.description: Finishing place, 1 for the winner. Runners in a dead heat share a place, and the next place skips (1, 2, 2, 4). Only a FINISHED runner has one; it is required for every FINISHED runner once the result is official.

startPosition.description: Post position (or grid slot); null when not known.

riderName.description: The jockey (or rider) for this start; null when not known.

row.description: One runner's result. The first identifier present is used: participantId, then externalId, then an exact case-insensitive playerName, matched within the event's field. Every value is stored exactly as sent.

resolution.description: How an uploaded row resolved to a participant: one match, none, or several.

sportEventParticipantId.description: The field row it resolved to; set only when MATCHED.

rowError.description: Why a resolved row cannot be applied. DUPLICATE_PARTICIPANT: another row names the same runner. POSITION_WITHOUT_FINISH: a finishing place on a runner that did not finish. FINISH_WITHOUT_POSITION: an official result for a FINISHED runner with no place.

change.description: Null when the row cannot be applied: not MATCHED, or a row error.

before.description: What is stored now; null when nothing is.

after.description: What is stored now; null when nothing is.

items.description: What applying one row would do.

rows.description: One per row sent, in the order sent.

items.description: Why the race's result as a whole cannot be applied. POSITIONS_INVALID: the finishing places, with the ones already stored for runners not named, do not run 1, 2, 3 ... with only a dead heat repeating a place and skipping the next. FIELD_INCOMPLETE: an official result leaves an active runner on the field with no result, or a FINISHED runner with no place.

orderErrors.description: Problems with the race's result as a whole; empty when it can be applied as far as the order goes.

invalid.description: Resolved rows with a row error.

RaceResultPreviewResponse.description: A dry run of a race result. Nothing is written.

MatchStatusDto.description: Where a match stands. COMPLETED once its result is in; CANCELLED when it was never played.

MatchSideDto.description: One side of a match. On a neutral site HOME is the upper line of the bracket.

MatchEndingDto.description: How a match with a result ended: PLAYED to its end; RETIREMENT, the loser stopped part way; WALKOVER, the loser never started; DEFAULT, the loser was disqualified. The winner wins in full every way.

periodNumber.description: 1 for the first period (quarter, in American football); never the last, whose score is the match's final result.

homeScore.description: The home side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included, as the scoreboard shows it.

awayScore.description: The away side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included.

SportEventMatchPeriodScoreDto.description: Both sides' score at the end of one period of a game (#772).

roundNumber.description: The round the match is played in; its label comes from the sport definition's round labels.

matchNumber.description: Unique within the event: the bracket slot and the display order.

homeSportEventParticipantId.description: The field row on the home side; null until it is decided, such as a later round waiting on its feeder match.

awaySportEventParticipantId.description: The field row on the away side; null until it is decided.

isNeutralSite.description: True when neither side is at home: screens then say "vs" rather than "@".

scheduledDate.description: Tip-off or kickoff; null until it is announced.

status.description: Where a match stands. COMPLETED once its result is in; CANCELLED when it was never played.

winnerSide.description: Who won; null until the match is COMPLETED. A COMPLETED match with none is a tie (#792), which only a game of a week, never a bracket match, can be.

homeScore.description: The home side's score; in a series, games won.

awayScore.description: The away side's score; in a series, games won.

homeShootoutScore.description: The home side's kicks scored in the shoot-out that settled a knockout match level after extra time; null with the away side's when there was none. Not part of the match score.

awayShootoutScore.description: The away side's kicks scored in the shoot-out; null with the home side's.

ending.description: How the match ended; PLAYED for a match without a result. A WALKOVER has no scores.

advancesToMatchId.description: The match the winner moves on to; null for the final.

advancesToSide.description: The side of that match the winner fills; null for the final.

regionLabel.description: The region or conference the match is played in ("AFC", "East"); null when the bracket has none. In a reseeded round each team stays in its region.

homeSpread.description: The points spread from the home team's side (#720): -3.5 has the home team favoured by 3.5, +3.5 has it getting 3.5. Null until set. A pick'em contest scored against the spread reads it.

homeSportEventParticipantId.description: Omitted keeps it; null empties the side. Only until the event is released.

awaySportEventParticipantId.description: Omitted keeps it; null empties the side. Only until the event is released.

scheduledDate.description: Omitted keeps it; null clears it.

homeSpread.description: The points spread from the home team's side, in half points (-3.5: the home team favoured by 3.5). Omitted keeps it; null clears it. Once the event is released, only while nobody has picked the game.

UpdateSportEventMatchRequest.description: One match edit. Its time and site can change at any point; its sides only until the event is released; its spread until someone picks the game.

participantId.description: Who takes the place: an active participant of the event's sport not yet on the field, such as a tennis lucky loser.

ReplaceWithdrawnParticipantRequest.description: A replacement for a field row that withdrew before its first match. The replacement gets its own field row in the withdrawn row's bracket place, unseeded, last in the event's last tier and at its lowest price. The withdrawn row stays on the field, inactive as WITHDRAWN, and every pick of it scores as a first-round loss.

winnerSide.description: The side that won; null for a tie (#792), which needs both scores, level. Only a game of a week, which forms no bracket, can end in a tie.

homeScore.description: The home side's score (games won, for a series), or null with the away score null too.

awayScore.description: The away side's score, or null with the home score null too.

homeShootoutScore.description: The home side's kicks scored in a shoot-out, for a bracket match level after extra time in a sport settled that way; omitted or null with the away side's for none.

awayShootoutScore.description: The away side's kicks scored in a shoot-out; omitted or null with the home side's.

ending.description: How the match ended; omitted is PLAYED. A RETIREMENT or DEFAULT takes both scores or neither, and the winner's may be the lower (where it stopped); a WALKOVER takes no scores. Neither a tie nor a shoot-out ends early.

RecordSportEventMatchResultRequest.description: A match's result: who won, or a tie, and both scores or neither. A match that ended early says how (ending). The winner's score must be the higher, except in a bracket match of a sport settled by shoot-out, where a level score takes both shoot-out scores and the winner's shoot-out score is the higher. Shoot-out scores are refused anywhere else. A tie, only in a game of a week, has level scores.

homeScore.description: The home side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included.

awayScore.description: The away side's score at the end of the period, earlier periods included.
