post.summary: Register a new user account
post.description: Creates a new username/email/password account, issues the initial auth tokens, and returns the authenticated user profile used to enter the PoolMaster app.

201.description: Successful authentication response returned after registration or login.

post.summary: Authenticate with username or email and password
post.description: Authenticates an existing account using username or email plus password, then returns the authenticated user profile plus fresh access, refresh, and CSRF tokens.

200.description: Successful authentication response returned after registration or login.

post.summary: Exchange refresh token for new access token
post.description: Rotates the refresh-token session forward and returns a new token bundle. Browser clients normally rely on the refresh cookie rather than sending a body payload.

200.description: Token refresh response carrying the rotated access, refresh and CSRF tokens.

post.summary: Revoke refresh token
post.description: Revokes the current refresh-token session so the browser or client must authenticate again before making further authenticated requests.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Public. Looks up the account by email or username and, when one matches, emails it a link that sets a new password. The link works once and expires after 10 minutes, and a newer request cancels it. The answer is 202 whether or not an account matched, so it never tells a caller which emails or usernames have accounts. 429 PASSWORD_RESET_RATE_LIMITED when this address has asked too often in the last minute.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link
post.description: Public; the token from the reset link is the whole authority. Sets the new password, cancels the account's other reset links and signs the account out on every device; the caller then signs in with the new password. 400 PASSWORD_RESET_LINK_INVALID for a link that is unknown, used, cancelled or expired (one code for all four), 400 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH when the two passwords differ, 429 PASSWORD_RESET_RATE_LIMITED when this address has tried too often in the last minute.

get.description: Returns every user, optionally filtered. This is the unscoped read: access rule A1 permits it to root admins only. Not paged — filters narrow the result, nothing slices it.
Returns one user as the canonical UserDto. `me` resolves to the authenticated caller. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin. Carries no viewer context (A8).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

delete.description: Removes the user row and the user-owned data that references it, in one transaction. Self-delete and admin-delete are ONE operation (A6). Gated: the account must already be inactive — the one place isActive is a write precondition rather than a read filter (A9) — the exact email must be confirmed, no league-scoped data may remain, and the last root admin cannot be removed.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates email, first name and last name. One operation for either caller — the subject themselves or a root admin (A6). The email must be unique across account emails and usernames.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates the login username after confirming it is unique across usernames AND emails, because login accepts either.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

put.description: Updates locale, timezone and date/time formatting. An omitted field is left unchanged; an explicit null clears it.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

get.summary: Read which categories of email a user gets
get.description: One switch per category of email a member can turn off, the same for every league; account and membership emails have none. Also says why the address gets no email at all, when it bounced for good or was marked as spam. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

200.description: Which categories of email the user gets, and whether their address can be emailed at all.

put.summary: Turn one category of email on or off
put.description: Sets one category's switch and returns them all. The same switch an email's "Stop these emails" link turns off. Access rule A6: the subject themselves, or a root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

200.description: Which categories of email the user gets, and whether their address can be emailed at all.

post.summary: Change your own password
post.description: Changes the password after validating the current one. Self only (A6): a root admin resetting somebody else uses the reset operation, which has a different subject rather than merely a different precondition. Other sessions are revoked while the caller stays signed in.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Reset another user's password
post.description: Generates a temporary password for the target user, revokes their live sessions, and returns the credential for the root admin to relay. Root admin only (A6).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Disable a user
post.description: Sets isActive = false and revokes every live session, atomically, except, when you inactivate yourself, the cookie session you did it from (A9: an inactive account may still sign in to reactivate or delete itself). Self-inactivation and admin-disable are ONE operation (A6). Idempotent: already inactive succeeds unchanged. Rejected for the last remaining active root admin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Enable a user
post.description: Sets isActive = true. Self-reactivation and admin-enable are ONE operation (A6). Idempotent. Re-enabling yourself rotates a fresh session so the account is immediately usable.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Revoke every live session for a user
post.description: Revokes all refresh tokens, forcing re-authentication. Self sign-out-everywhere and admin force-logout are ONE operation (A6).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

post.summary: Grant or revoke the root-admin role
post.description: Root admin only (A6). Self-demotion is permitted: the only rule is that the platform keeps an administrator, which the last-root-admin guard enforces for every caller. A demotion also revokes the subject's sessions so the removed authority cannot be used until re-login.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: `me` for the authenticated caller, or a user id.

get.description: Returns non-secret deployment metadata for the core API service so QA and operators can diagnose stale releases, SHA mismatches, and build provenance.

200.description: Public service version metadata for deployment and stale-release diagnostics.

get.description:
Returns leagues together with the viewer's own memberships once as an array. The leagues list is the one inherently multi-league surface, so it is the one place the viewer's relationship travels as a set rather than per row (access rule A8).

`scope` selects which leagues: `mine` (the default) returns the leagues the caller belongs to and powers the welcome page, header selector and My Leagues overview; `all` returns every league on the platform and powers root-admin league management. `all` is the unscoped read access rule A1 permits to root admins only, and returns 403 otherwise. `search` and `isActive` narrow either scope.

This replaced `listLeagues` + `adminListLeagues`, which were one operation split by caller role.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which leagues to return: 'mine' (default) for the leagues the caller belongs to, 'all' for every league on the platform. 'all' requires root-admin access.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against the league name. A filter, never a slice — see §16.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Optional active/inactive filter. Omitted returns both.

200.description: League-list response, with the viewer's memberships once as an array.

post.summary: Create a new league
post.description:
Creates a new private league for the authenticated commissioner using the submitted unique `leagueCode`, then returns the new league together with the creator's own membership edges in it.

The same `LeagueContextResponse` as `getLeague` and `getLeagueByCode`, because creating a league also creates the creator's COMMISSIONER membership: the client navigates straight into the league and seeds its context cache from this response rather than issuing a second read (access rule A8). `squadMembership` is null by construction — a league has no squads the instant it is created.

201.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

get.summary: Get a league and the viewer's context in it, by ID
get.description:
Returns a league by internal league ID together with the viewer's own membership edges in it — their LeagueMembership and their SquadMembership — for authenticated league members, league commissioners, or root admins using platform-level override access.

The same `LeagueContextResponse` as `getLeagueByCode`: two ways to find one league, one response shape. Use this route when you hold a league ID rather than a league code, as contest-rooted surfaces do (access rule A8).

404 LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND for a league that does not exist; otherwise active members only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE.

200.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an inactive league after the caller types the exact `leagueCode` confirmation. This removes league-owned data and relationships while preserving user accounts.

One operation for both callers: a commissioner of the league, or a root admin exercising platform authority. This replaced `deleteLeague` + `adminDeleteLeague`.

get.summary: Get league details by league code
get.description: The league-context call. Returns a league by its stable league code together with the viewer's own membership edges in it — their LeagueMembership and their SquadMembership. This is the preferred route for bookmarkable `/league/<leagueCode>` web navigation, it allows root-admin override access without faking league membership, and it is the one response that carries viewer context: every other league-scoped response omits it because the client already holds this one (access rule A8).

200.description: A league together with the viewer's own membership edges in it. Fetched once per league; nothing else repeats this context.

put.description: Allows a commissioner to edit an active league's name, description and built-in icon in one request, so the change applies whole or not at all. League code remains immutable after creation.

Allows a commissioner to set an active league's championship name and points table (#841, #863) in one request. Cups score on read, so they follow the new table at once; the championship keeps the points each contest earned when it went final. 400 CUP_CUSTOM_POINTS_INVALID when CUSTOM has no points or another scale sends some; LEAGUE_DETAILS_READ_ONLY_WHEN_INACTIVE for an inactive league.

post.summary: Inactivate a league
post.description:
Marks a league inactive. Inactive leagues remain visible, but this action is the required first step before a permanent delete becomes available.

One operation for both callers: a commissioner of the league, or a root admin exercising platform authority. This replaced `inactivateLeague` + `adminInactivateLeague`.

post.summary: Activate a league
post.description: Allows a commissioner to reactivate an inactive league so normal league usage and commissioner edits become available again.

post.summary: Send email invitations to join a league
post.description: Creates direct email invitations for the target league and queues each one's email; each sent invitation carries its email status. Existing members and pending duplicate invitees are reported separately in the response. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

get.description: Lists the league's outstanding invitations, newest first: every PENDING email invite and join link, plus email invites that expired without being accepted, each email invite with where its latest email stands. Accepted and cancelled invitations are not listed. Commissioner only.

200.description: Commissioner list of a league's pending invitations.

post.summary: Resend an email invitation
post.description: Renews an outstanding email invitation: a new invite code (the old link stops working), a new expiry, and the invitation email queued again. 409 LEAGUE_INVITATION_NOT_RESENDABLE for a join link or an accepted or cancelled invitation, and 409 LEAGUE_INACTIVE while the league is inactive. Commissioner only.

post.summary: Generate a shareable invite link
post.description: Creates a reusable invitation link for the target league. The resulting invite code is later previewed through the public invitation endpoints. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

delete.description: Cancels an outstanding invitation by its invite code, a shareable join link or an email invite, so the code can no longer be accepted. The invitation becomes REVOKED. An invitation already accepted or cancelled is refused with 409 LEAGUE_INVITATION_NOT_CANCELLABLE.

get.description: Returns the current league membership list for authenticated members and commissioners. This powers member rosters and commissioner management surfaces.

200.description: League-members response. Each member is the membership edge with the user embedded.

put.summary: Change a member role and permissions
put.description: Allows a commissioner to promote or demote a member within the league.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the league
delete.description: Removes a member from the target league. Commissioners use this to manage league membership directly.

delete.summary: Leave a league as the current member
delete.description: Allows the authenticated user to leave a league through their own membership rather than through a commissioner-managed removal flow.

post.summary: Bulk-import members via CSV rows
post.description: Imports member rows for the league and creates invitations or memberships according to the validated bulk payload.

201.description: Result of a bulk CSV member import.

get.description: Returns the squads associated with the current league for squad management and contest-entry flows, including requester-scoped teamRelationship plus separate global isRootAdmin flags.

post.summary: Create a squad in a league
post.description: Creates a squad in the target league for commissioner or member-managed squad participation.

get.description: Returns the detailed squad payload for the requested squad identifier, including requester-scoped teamRelationship plus separate global isRootAdmin flags.

patch.description: Updates mutable squad fields such as naming and presentation detail for an active squad owner, league commissioner, or root admin.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an inactive squad and cascades related squad-owned data. This route is root-admin only and exists to support QA cleanup flows from the web app. Refused with 400 SQUAD_DELETE_REQUIRES_INACTIVE for an active squad, and with 400 SQUAD_DELETE_HAS_RESULTS for a squad with a place in a finished contest, whose results cups and championships keep.

post.summary: Inactivate a squad
post.description:
Inactivates the target squad, preserves its history, removes its active owners from the league, and revokes its pending co-owner invitations so an old invite cannot revive it. Refused with LEAGUE_LAST_COMMISSIONER_REQUIRED when the squad's owners are every active commissioner the league has. It does NOT touch their user accounts — they can still sign in, and a commissioner can invite them back, which restores their original squad (#218).

**League commissioners and root admins only (#219).** Squad owners may invite and remove co-owners on their own squad, but ending a squad also ends its owners' league memberships, so it is league administration rather than squad management.

post.summary: Add or reactivate a squad owner
post.description: Adds an owner to the squad or reactivates an existing inactive owner membership for an active squad owner, league commissioner, or root admin.

delete.description: Removes the owner relationship between the target user and squad. The backend blocks removal of the final active owner and requires squad inactivation instead.

get.summary: List co-owner invitations for a league
get.description: Returns pending and historical co-owner invitations visible to the current commissioner, active squad owner, or root admin.

post.summary: Invite a co-owner by email
post.description: Starts the co-owner invite flow for a squad. Existing PoolMaster users outside the league may be provisioned immediately; current league members are rejected. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`. Active squad owners, league commissioners, and root admins may start this flow.

post.summary: Replace an active squad owner
post.description: Guided replacement flow that removes the selected current owner (ending their squad and league membership, as removing an owner does) and starts the same co-owner invite/provisioning flow for the replacement email. Refused when the owner being replaced is the league's last active commissioner, and in an inactive league (400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`). A squad owner may replace a co-owner; a league commissioner or root admin may also replace a squad's only owner, and the squad stays active for the replacement.

delete.description: Revokes a pending co-owner invitation so it can no longer be accepted. Active squad owners, league commissioners, and root admins may revoke invitations in their allowed scope.

get.summary: Preview a league invitation by invite code
get.description: Returns the minimal league identity and invitation state needed to render the public `/invite/<inviteCode>` entry flow before or after authentication.

200.description: Invitation preview payload used by `/invite/<inviteCode>` flows.

post.summary: Accept a league invitation using an invite code
post.description: Accepts an invitation for the authenticated user and creates or reactivates a MEMBER membership in the target league. An email invitation can be accepted only by the account whose email it was sent to (400 `LEAGUE_INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`); an invite link can be used by anyone holding it. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`.

get.summary: Preview a co-owner invitation by invite code
get.description: Returns the minimal league and squad identity needed to render the public co-owner invitation flow before or after authentication.

200.description: Public preview payload for a team-owner invitation.

post.summary: Accept a co-owner invitation using an invite code
post.description: Accepts a co-owner invitation for the authenticated user and provisions league membership plus squad ownership on the target squad. Only the account whose email the invitation was sent to may accept it (400 `SQUAD_OWNER_INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`). An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`, and a squad that has gone inactive since the invitation was sent refuses with 400 `SQUAD_INACTIVE`.

post.summary: Register a new account against a co-owner invitation and accept it
post.description:
Creates a PoolMaster account for an invited co-owner who does not have one yet, then joins them to the league and the invited squad — registration, league membership and squad ownership in a single request. Returns the new account with a session, so the invitee is signed in and lands on their squad.

Unauthenticated by design: the caller has no account yet, which is why `acceptTeamOwnerInvitation` cannot serve them. When the invited email already belongs to a user, `createSquadOwnerInvitation` provisions them immediately and the invitation comes back ACCEPTED, so there is nothing to accept and this route returns 400 `SQUAD_OWNER_INVITATION_ACCOUNT_EXISTS`.

The account is created with the address the invitation was sent to; the request carries no email. A co-owner invitation grants league membership, so honouring an address supplied by the caller would let a forwarded invite link admit an unintended person. An inactive league refuses with 400 `LEAGUE_INACTIVE`, and a squad that has gone inactive since the invitation was sent refuses with 400 `SQUAD_INACTIVE`.

201.description: Successful authentication response returned after registration or login.

get.description: Returns the contests associated with the parent league so league-home and commissioner views can list current and historical contests. Each contest carries its entry count and its sport event's name and start, so a list needs no per-event reads. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

post.summary: Create a new contest in a league
post.description: The one way a contest is created. Name a template, supply a configuration, or both: the template seeds the configuration and `configuration` replaces it. A request with neither is refused with 400 CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED — there is no platform default. A template that names a sport league (that league's own preset) makes contests only for that league's events: 422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_LEAGUE_MISMATCH otherwise. Commissioners of the league only.

201.description: Single-contest response. A contest's rules are on the contest-management read (commissioners) and the selection-state read (entries).

400.description: CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED when neither `templateId` nor `configuration` is supplied; otherwise a request that does not match the schema.

409.description: Budget rules the event cannot run. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED — the event's golfers have no prices, so there is no salary cap. CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — the cheapest golfers for every roster place cost more than the cap.

422.description: The event, format or template cannot make this contest. The event: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND, SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED, SPORT_EVENT_FIELD_NOT_LOADED, SPORT_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED. The format: CONTEST_FORMAT_NOT_ALLOWED. The games of a pick'em or survivor contest: CONTEST_EVENT_HAS_NO_GAMES, CONTEST_EVENT_GAME_UNDECIDED, or CONTEST_EVENT_SPREAD_MISSING (a pick'em pool against the spread on a week with a game lacking its spread). CONTEST_SPREAD_NOT_OFFERED: a pick'em pool against the spread in a sport whose pools have no spread (#792). The selection type: CONTEST_SELECTION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (the event's sport does not offer it). The configuration: CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH (rules of another selection type than the contest's), CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE, CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE (counted scores above the roster size), CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_INVALID (template missing, inactive, or for another format or selection type), or CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_LEAGUE_MISMATCH (the template is one sport league's own preset and the event belongs to another league; a template with no sport league is offered for every league of its sport).

get.description: Returns a contest with its configuration and the tiers it inherits from its event: what the configuration editor reads. Commissioner only. Named for the object it returns, not the role that reads it (#248; was getManagedContest).

put.description: Updates a draft contest's configuration and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. Refused with 409 CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED once the contest is no longer DRAFT: opening it to the league locks its settings for good.

409.description: CONTEST_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED — the contest has been opened to the league (it is not DRAFT), so its configuration can no longer change. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED — budget rules on an event whose golfers have no prices. CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — the cheapest golfers for every roster place cost more than the event's salary cap.

422.description: CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH — the rules are of another selection type than the contest's. CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — the tiered rules do not fit the event's tiers. CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — counted scores above the roster size.

post.summary: Open a draft contest to the league
post.description: Moves a DRAFT contest to OPEN so league members can see and enter it, and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. There is no undo: from here its name, configuration and existence are locked. The event's field need not be ready; entries wait on it.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, or SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND when the contest's event is gone.

409.description: CONTEST_NOT_DRAFT — the contest is already open, or past it. CONTEST_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED — the event's start time has passed or it is IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED or CANCELLED; the draft stays a draft. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED or CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — budget rules the event's active field can no longer fill under its salary cap, for example after withdrawals; edit the draft first.

422.description: CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — the stored configuration no longer fits the event's tiers; edit the draft first. CONTEST_RULES_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH or CONTEST_BUDGET_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE — stored rules that break their selection type's checks. CONTEST_SELECTION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED — the event's sport no longer offers the contest's selection type.

put.summary: Set how much a contest counts toward its cup
put.description: Sets how much the contest counts toward its sports league cup and the league championship (#841) and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. Allowed while the contest is DRAFT, OPEN or ACTIVE; once it is COMPLETED its weight is fixed, because the championship keeps the points it earned at settlement.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND — no such contest in this league.

409.description: CONTEST_FINAL — the contest is COMPLETED, so its weight is fixed.

put.summary: Set the events a contest covers
put.description: Sets the events the contest covers (#713) and returns it as getContestConfiguration does. Commissioner only. Send every event the contest should cover; one left out is removed, and its picks with it. The contest keeps its events in start-date order. An added event must be released, have its field loaded, not have started, and be from the contest's sport league; the contest's rules are checked against it as at create. Events can be added while the contest is DRAFT, OPEN or ACTIVE, and removed only while none of its events has started.

404.description: CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, or SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND for an event that does not exist.

409.description: CONTEST_EVENTS_LOCKED — an event would be removed after one of the contest's events started, or the contest is COMPLETED or drawn. CONTEST_BUDGET_SALARY_CAP_MISMATCH — a budget contest's events were priced against different salary caps, or an open one's new event against another cap than its entries were built under. CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED or CONTEST_BUDGET_UNFILLABLE — budget rules an added event cannot fill.

422.description: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED, SPORT_EVENT_FIELD_NOT_LOADED or SPORT_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED — an added event is not one contests can be built on. CONTEST_EVENTS_LEAGUE_MISMATCH — an event from another sport league. CONTEST_DRAW_SINGLE_EVENT — a random-draw contest given more than one event. CONTEST_BRACKET_SINGLE_EVENT — a bracket contest given more than one event. CONTEST_TIER_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE or CONTEST_SCORING_ROUNDS_MISMATCH — the rules do not fit an added event. CONTEST_EVENT_HAS_NO_GAMES, CONTEST_EVENT_GAME_UNDECIDED or CONTEST_EVENT_SPREAD_MISSING — an added week cannot be picked under the pick'em rules. CONTEST_SPREAD_NOT_OFFERED — a pick'em pool against the spread in a sport whose pools have no spread (#792).

get.description: Returns detailed contest information by contest ID for league, entry, and history surfaces that already know the contest identifier. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: Single-contest response. A contest's rules are on the contest-management read (commissioners) and the selection-state read (entries).

put.description: Updates mutable contest fields for the target contest and returns the refreshed contest payload. Commissioners of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_PERMISSION_DENIED for a member who is not a commissioner, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED for a non-member.

200.description: Single-contest response. A contest's rules are on the contest-management read (commissioners) and the selection-state read (entries).

delete.description: Deletes the target contest when the contest is still DRAFT. Commissioners of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_PERMISSION_DENIED for a member who is not a commissioner, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED for a non-member.

get.description: Lists the contest entries currently registered for the contest, including data needed for administration and participant views. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

Returns a contest entry plus its picked participants. Scores are exposed by the contest leaderboard endpoint rather than copied onto picks. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

patch.description: Updates mutable contest-entry fields such as name and tiebreaker prediction while the contest is OPEN and its event has not reached its scheduled start (400 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise). Acting for a squad needs an ACTIVE league membership and an ACTIVE squad membership: 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, or SQUAD_MANAGER_REQUIRED when the caller has no squad.

get.description: Returns the member-facing leaderboard for a contest, as the cross-sport ContestLeaderboardResponse. Each entry carries its contest total and rank, its score and place in each of the contest's events whose picks are revealed (#713), and its picks in one shown event: `sportEventId`, else the latest revealed event. While an event is live, its entry standings are computed from the event's standings and joined to entry picks in memory, so picks remain pointers into `participants` (the shown event's own field rows). Once an event completes, its entries' scores, ranks and pick counts come from the standings frozen when it settled, and once the contest is COMPLETED its totals come from the standings frozen at settlement, so a later score correction does not change a settled result; the event field still shows current scores. `scoringDefinitionId` names the scoring definition the leaderboard was ranked by; render scores and rounds through it. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

parameters.name: sportEventId
parameters.description: The contest event whose field and picks to show; its picks must be revealed. Defaults to the contest's latest event whose picks are revealed.

200.description: Member-facing contest leaderboard. Live, entry standings are computed from the events' standings; a completed event answers from the standings frozen when it settled, and a COMPLETED contest's totals are the ones frozen at its settlement.

400.description: CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH (a prediction contest: a bracket, a pick'em pool and a survivor pool have their own leaderboards, getBracketLeaderboard, getPickEmLeaderboard and getSurvivorLeaderboard), CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST (the asked-for event is not one the contest covers), CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_PICKS_HIDDEN (no event's picks are revealed yet, or not the asked-for one's), _EVENT_REQUIRED, _COUNTING_RULE_MISSING, _SCORING_RULE_MISSING (the configuration carries no participant scoring rule), _SCORING_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN (its rule names a definition the registry does not know) or _SCORING_SETTINGS_INVALID (its rule's settings are not valid for that definition).

get.description: Returns a bracket contest's leaderboard (#721): each entry that submitted its bracket, with its points so far (a correct pick earns its round's value plus any upset bonus, under the contest's knockout round points), the most it can still reach (its points plus the round value of every pick whose team is still in), and its place. Entries level on points are ordered, once the final is played, by how close their tiebreaker was to the final's total points; entries still level share a place. Available once the event has started and picks are revealed. Once the contest is COMPLETED, points and places come from the standings frozen at settlement, so a later result correction does not change a settled place. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

400.description: CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH (not a bracket contest), CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_PICKS_HIDDEN (the event has not started), or CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_SCORING_RULE_MISSING, _SCORING_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN (its rule is not knockout round points) or _SCORING_SETTINGS_INVALID.

get.description: Returns a pick'em contest's season leaderboard (#717): each entry that submitted at least one week, with its season total and, for each week, its points and place. A correct pick earns 1 point straight up, or its confidence value in a confidence pool; a pick on a lost game, a tie or a cancelled game earns nothing, and a week still in draft at its first kickoff scores nothing. Entries level on a week's points are ordered, once the week's last game is played, by how close their tiebreaker was to that game's total points; entries still level share the place. A week under way is scored live from its played games. Once a week settles, its points and places are frozen and its first-place entries are its winners; a later result correction changes nothing. Once the contest is COMPLETED, the season totals and places come from the standings frozen at settlement. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: A pick'em contest's season leaderboard: the season total, each week's points and places, and the weekly winners.

get.description: Returns a survivor contest's leaderboard (#719): each entry that submitted at least one week, whether it is still in or the week that put it out, and its weeks survived. An entry picks one team a week, each team once a season; it survives the week when that team wins or its game is cancelled, and goes out after a loss, a tie, or a week not submitted by its first kickoff. A cancelled week counts for nothing. Entries still in come first, then by weeks survived; entries out in the same week share a place. Each week shows the entry's outcome and, once its game has kicked off, the team it picked. Read live from the results; once the contest is COMPLETED, the places come from the standings frozen at settlement. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: A survivor contest's leaderboard: who is still in, and when each entry went out.

post.summary: Create the current user contest entry
post.description: Creates a new contest entry for the authenticated user. This route never returns an existing entry; clients should use the GET entry endpoints to inspect current entry state before or after creation. Entries change only while the contest is OPEN and before its event's scheduled start: 400 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise. Acting for a squad needs an ACTIVE league membership and an ACTIVE squad membership: 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, or SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED when the caller has no squad.

delete.summary: Delete the current user contest entry
delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user contest entry when the contest rules still allow the user to leave the contest: the contest is OPEN, its event has not reached its scheduled start, and the entry has no picks. Acting for a squad needs an ACTIVE league membership and an ACTIVE squad membership: 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, or SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED when the caller has no squad.

get.description: The league's sports league cups of one season, oldest first: one per sports league the league has a contest of that season in, each with its standings and its contests. Standings are worked out from the contests' frozen places: a squad scores from its best entry on the league's points table, times each contest's weight. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

parameters.name: seasonYear
parameters.description: The season whose cups to list, such as 2026.

get.description: One cup with its standings and contests: the Points race. 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND for a cup that is not the league's. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

One squad's points in a cup, counted contest by counted contest, in the order they went final. 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND for a cup that is not the league's, SQUAD_NOT_FOUND for a squad that is not. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

Every year the league has a counted contest in, newest first, with the squads in 1st: the champions of a year that is over, the leaders of the current one. Years with no counted contest are left out. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

One year of the league championship: every counted contest of every sport that went final in the calendar year (US Eastern), each squad scoring from its best entry with the points it earned at settlement. Standings with the finish matrix, and the medal tiles. A year with no counted contest answers every active squad at 0. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The championship year, such as 2026.

get.description: The seeded configurations a contest can be created from. Anyone may read them, signed in or not: they are product copy shown on the public How to Play page. Every filter is optional; the create flow asks for one sport's active templates, narrowed to the chosen event's sport league (that league's templates plus the sport-wide ones) and kind of event.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only templates for this sport.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: Templates for this sport league plus the sport-wide ones (null sportLeagueId); never another league's. Omitted: every template regardless of league. The create flow passes the chosen event's sport league.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Templates for this kind of event, plus the ones offered for every event of their sport. The create flow passes the chosen event's kind for a sport played as matches.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only active (true) or inactive (false) templates. Omitted: both. The create flow asks for active ones.

200.description: Available seeded contest templates for commissioner create flow.

put.description: Updates a seeded template that future contests are created from. Root admin only (403 ROOT_ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED otherwise); contests already created from it keep their own configuration. A configuration must be the template's own selection type's rules (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_RULES_MISMATCH otherwise).

get.description: The sport-event catalog, narrowed by sport, status, sport league, event year and name and never paged. Any signed-in user may read it: contest setup picks an event from it, and a root admin browses it. Each event carries its loaded field size, contest-setup readiness, and its tier and contest counts. DRAFT events (not yet released for contests) are listed for a root admin only.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only events of this sport.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only events in this lifecycle status.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: Only events of this sport league's series.

parameters.name: eventYear
parameters.description: Only editions branded with this year.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the event name.

post.summary: Create a sport event
post.description: An admin-authored edition of a series in an event year, SCHEDULED, accepting no provider data, with its default rounds and tiers. The series is found or created in the sport league by the event's name; 409 EVENT_EDITION_ALREADY_EXISTS when it already has an edition that year. The sport comes from the sport league. Root admin only.

get.description: 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND for a DRAFT event unless the caller is a root admin.

patch.description: Edits any event, linked to a provider or not; a provider never overwrites these fields. A new startDate moves every round by the same amount; a higher rounds count adds rounds, each a day after the one before. Root admin only.

delete.description: Deletes the event with its rounds, tiers and field. 409 EVENT_HAS_CONTESTS while any contest runs on it. Root admin only.

post.summary: Clone a sport league's event year forward
post.description: Re-creates each of a sport league's events in one event year as a fresh event in another (default: the next), dates shifted by the year difference and in the same series (plans/124 §4.2a, plans/147). Fields, tiers, prices, scores and provider links are never copied, and the current event year does not change. 422 EVENT_YEAR_HAS_NO_EVENTS for an empty source year; 409 EVENT_YEAR_NOT_EMPTY when the target year already has events. Root admin only.

post.summary: Import a tour's event year from a provider
post.description: Creates each provider event for the sport league's tour starting in eventYear that PoolMaster does not have yet, each linked to it for scores (SCORES_ONLY) exactly as createEventFromProviderEvent would (#385). A provider event belongs to the tour when its metadata.tour equals the sport league's matchKeyword, ignoring case. Events already linked, and series that already have an edition that year, are skipped and reported, so the import can be re-run. Fields are not loaded. 404 PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND or SPORT_LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND; 422 SPORT_LEAGUE_HAS_NO_MATCH_KEYWORD. Root admin only.

201.description: What an event-year import created and skipped. Running it again creates nothing new.

post.summary: Create a sport event from a provider event
post.description: An event named and dated by a browsed provider event, linked to it for scores (SCORES_ONLY). The field is not loaded; refreshEventParticipants does that. 409 EXTERNAL_EVENT_ALREADY_LINKED when another event holds the identity, EVENT_EDITION_ALREADY_EXISTS when the series already has an edition that year. Root admin only.

post.summary: Release a draft sport event for contests
post.description: DRAFT → SCHEDULED. Commissioners can then see the event and build contests on it, and its tiers and prices are locked for good. Refused unless the field is loaded, every active participant has a tier, every tier has an active participant, and the start time has not passed. An event whose sport plays a bracket also needs its bracket complete (every side of every match named or filled by an earlier winner, every active field member in it, nobody withdrawn left in it), and its seeds lock at release. Root admin only.

409.description: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_DRAFT: the event has already been released. SPORT_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED: its start time has passed.

422.description: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_READY: the field is not loaded, an active participant has no tier, a tier has no active participant, prices are not assigned or miss an active participant, or a bracket event's bracket is incomplete.

post.summary: Move a sport event to its next status
post.description: Only to one of the event's allowedTransitions. Activates or settles its contests as the new status requires. A DRAFT event is refused SCHEDULED with 409 SPORT_EVENT_RELEASE_REQUIRED: releasing it is its own action (releaseEvent). Root admin only.

put.summary: Link a sport event to a provider event for scores
put.description: 404 PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND when no provider is registered under the id; 422 PROVIDER_SPORT_MISMATCH when the provider does not cover the event's sport; 409 EXTERNAL_EVENT_ALREADY_LINKED when another event holds the identity. Root admin only.

delete.summary: Unlink a sport event from its provider

get.summary: Get the simulated live scoring running for an event
get.description: Root admin only. The simulation started by startEventLiveSimulation, with its current round; poll it to watch the simulation advance. 404 LIVE_SIMULATION_NOT_RUNNING when none is running: never started, or the provider restarted and forgot it.

200.description: A running simulated live-scoring replay. Scores reach PoolMaster through the normal live-score sync, which polls only while the event is IN_PROGRESS.

post.summary: Start simulated live scoring from the event's score source
post.description: Root admin only. For testing a live contest: asks the linked provider to play the event's four rounds forward on its own clock, hole by hole; calling again restarts from round 1. Scores reach PoolMaster through the normal live-score sync, which polls only while the event is IN_PROGRESS. Only providers whose summary has supportsLiveSimulation (the QA mock feed) accept it.

200.description: A running simulated live-scoring replay. Scores reach PoolMaster through the normal live-score sync, which polls only while the event is IN_PROGRESS.

patch.description: Moves existing rounds, all or none; 404 ROUND_NOT_FOUND for a round the event lacks. Root admin only.

get.description: Every participant on the field with its canonical participant, valuation, standing and rounds, in seed order.

post.summary: Add participants to a sport event's field
post.description: Any participants; ones already on the field are skipped. Root admin only.

patch.description: Patches field rows and their manual prices, all or none. Root admin only. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED when a released event's price would change: its tiers and prices are locked. 409 SPORT_EVENT_SEEDS_LOCKED when a released bracket event's seed would change: the upset bonus reads the seeds as they stood at release.

post.summary: Seed a sport event's field from its sport league
post.description: Adds the sport league's active affiliations with derived seeds and odds; ones already on the field are skipped. Root admin only.

200.description: What seeding the field from the event's sport league did.

post.summary: Reload a sport event's field from its provider
post.description: Queues a provider sync of the field and returns at once; reload the field once the sync runs complete. 409 EVENT_NOT_LINKED for an event with no provider. Root admin only.

202.description: A manual sync submission. The runs execute asynchronously after the request is accepted.

post.summary: Preview a field upload
post.description: Resolves each row against the event's field — participantId, then externalId, then an exact case-insensitive playerName, with no fallback — and reports what applying it would change to ranking, oddsToWin, seedNumber, isActive and inactiveReason. A participant not on the field is UNRESOLVED: the upload never adds one, so the field is loaded from the provider first. A participant named by two rows is a DUPLICATE_PARTICIPANT row error. Writes nothing. Root admin only.

200.description: A dry run of a field upload. Nothing is written.

post.summary: Apply a field upload
post.description: Re-runs the preview, then patches every changed row in one transaction, all or none. 422 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_UPLOAD_ROWS_UNRESOLVED, with nothing written, when any row is not MATCHED or is a duplicate. Omitted values are left alone; null clears. A later field refresh from the provider replaces these values as it does grid edits, except a released bracket event's seeds. 409 SPORT_EVENT_SEEDS_LOCKED when a released bracket event's seed would change. Returns the field. Root admin only.

delete.summary: Remove a participant from a sport event's field
delete.description: 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_HAS_PICKS once a contest entry has picked it — withdraw it instead. 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_IN_BRACKET while a bracket match names it. Root admin only.

get.description: Who is in each tier is on each field row's valuation (listEventParticipants).

put.description: 409 TIER_REPLACE_WOULD_ORPHAN_ASSIGNMENTS when a removed tier still has participants and no reassignOrphansTo is given. Root admin only.

post.summary: Fill a sport event's tiers from its active field
post.description: Returns the field with its new valuations. Root admin only. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the event is released: its tiers and prices are locked.

put.summary: Replace a sport event's tier assignments
put.description: The drag-and-drop save, all or none. Returns the field with its new valuations. Root admin only. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the event is released: its tiers and prices are locked.

post.summary: Price a sport event's seeded field
post.description: Prices the active field on the budget curve with the values sent, best seed first and golfers with no seed last, and stores the values as the event's pricing. Repeatable until release. Returns the field with its new valuations. Root admin only. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the event is released: its tiers and prices are locked. 422 PRICING_CONFIG_INVALID when the floor share is above the top share or the rounding unit is above the worst golfer's price (salaryCap × floorSharePercent / 100), which could round prices to $0.

post.summary: Preview a round of golf scores
post.description: Resolves each row against the event's field and reports what it would change. post.description: Resolves each row against the event's field and reports what applying it would change, with each row's error and the order's as a whole. Writes nothing. 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by finishing place (its scoring family is not finish position). Root admin only.

200.description: A dry run of a race result. Nothing is written.

put.description: Stores each runner's result exactly as sent, all or none; runners not named keep theirs. The official flag is set on every result of the race. Writes each runner's standing: its place (a dead heat sharing one, shown "T2"), COMPLETE once it started, WITHDRAWN when it did not start. 422 RACE_RESULT_ROWS_INVALID when a row does not resolve to one runner or carries a row error; 422 RACE_RESULT_POSITIONS_INVALID when the places do not run 1, 2, 3 ... (a dead heat repeats a place and skips the next); 422 RACE_RESULT_FIELD_INCOMPLETE when an official result leaves an active runner without a result or a finisher without a place; 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by finishing place. Returns the field. Root admin only.

get.description: Every match of the event in match-number order, empty until the bracket is loaded. Any signed-in user may read a released event's bracket; a DRAFT event's is a root admin's only. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket.

put.description: Replaces every match of the event with the matches sent, all or none. A side may be left empty while its team is not known; release needs the bracket complete. 409 SPORT_EVENT_BRACKET_LOCKED once the event is released. 422 BRACKET_INVALID, naming every problem, when a match number repeats, a round is not the event's, a side names a field row the event lacks or one already named, a winner advances to a match that is missing or not in a later round or to a side that names a team or that another match fills, or there is not exactly one final in the last round. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

patch.summary: Edit one match of a sport event's bracket
patch.description: Values left out keep what is stored. The time and site can change at any point; the sides only until release (409 SPORT_EVENT_BRACKET_LOCKED). The home spread can change until release, and after it only while no entry has picked the game (409 MATCH_SPREAD_LOCKED), and never cleared (422 MATCH_SPREAD_REQUIRED). 422 BRACKET_INVALID when a side would name a field row the event lacks or one another match names, a side an earlier match's winner fills, or both sides one team. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND for a match number the bracket lacks. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Root admin only.

200.description: One match of an event's bracket.

put.description: Completes the match with its winner and scores, puts the winner on the side of the match it advances to, and rewrites every team's event standing from the bracket (the champion 1, a team that lost ELIMINATED). A week of games that forms no bracket ranks no team: a team is COMPLETE once its game is played or cancelled. A game of such a week can end in a tie (#792): a null winnerSide with both scores level. Re-sending a match's result changes it. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 422 MATCH_SIDES_NOT_SET while a side waits for an earlier winner. A bracket match level after extra time, in a sport settled by shoot-out, takes both shoot-out scores and the winner's is the higher; they are kept apart from the match score. A match that ended early says how (ending): after a RETIREMENT or DEFAULT the winner's score may be the lower, and a WALKOVER has no scores; its winner wins in full. 422 MATCH_RESULT_INVALID for one score without the other, a winner without the higher score in a match played to its end, a tie without level scores, a tie in a bracket match, shoot-out scores on a match that is not a level bracket match of such a sport, a tie or shoot-out that ended early, or a walkover with scores or period scores. 409 SPORT_EVENT_MATCH_RESULT_LOCKED once the match its winner advanced to has a result or a period score: clear those first. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

delete.description: The match is scheduled again, the side its winner filled is emptied and the standings are rewritten. Clearing a match with no result changes nothing. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 SPORT_EVENT_MATCH_RESULT_LOCKED once the match its winner advanced to has a result or a period score: clear those first. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

put.summary: Enter a game's score at the end of a period
put.description: Both sides' score at the end of one period before the last (the end of the first, second or third quarter in American football), as the scoreboard shows it. It can be entered while the game is played and corrected after it; re-sending it changes it. Squares pools read it. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 MATCH_CANCELLED for a cancelled game. 422 MATCH_PERIOD_INVALID when the event's sport keeps no score by period, or for the last period or past it, whose score is the final result. 422 MATCH_SIDES_NOT_SET while a side waits for its team. 422 MATCH_PERIOD_SCORE_INVALID when a side's score is below its score at an earlier period's end, or above its score at a later one's or its final score, and for a game that was a walkover. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

delete.summary: Clear a game's score at the end of a period
delete.description: Clearing a score that is not entered changes nothing. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 MATCH_CANCELLED for a cancelled game. 422 MATCH_PERIOD_INVALID when the event's sport keeps no score by period, or for the last period or past it, whose score is the final result. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

post.summary: Cancel a game
post.description: Calls off an unplayed game of a released week whose games form no bracket, such as a postponed NFL game: it counts for nothing in any contest, and is added to the week it moves to while that week is a draft. Cancelling a cancelled game changes nothing. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft, whose games are edited freely. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 MATCH_ALREADY_PLAYED for a game with a result (clear it first). 422 MATCH_IN_BRACKET for a game of a bracket, which cannot lose one. Returns the games. Root admin only.

get.description: For a league that reseeds (the NFL after Wild Card weekend): in each region the best seed left hosts the worst and the second best the second worst; a bye or a linked winner keeps its place. Saves nothing. 422 BRACKET_NOT_RESEEDED when the event's league does not reseed or the round is not one placed by seed. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 409 BRACKET_ROUND_NOT_FINISHED while a match of the round before has no result; 409 BRACKET_ROUND_ALREADY_PLAYED once a match of the round has started or has a period score. 422 BRACKET_INVALID when the teams left do not fit the round. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Root admin only.

200.description: The pairing the server proposes for a reseeded round: in each region the best seed left hosts the worst, the second best the second worst, and a team already holding its place keeps it.

put.description: Places both sides of every match of the round, all or none; it can be set again until the round starts. 422 BRACKET_NOT_RESEEDED when the event's league does not reseed or the round is not one placed by seed. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 409 BRACKET_ROUND_NOT_FINISHED while a match of the round before has no result; 409 BRACKET_ROUND_ALREADY_PLAYED once a match of the round has started or has a period score. 422 BRACKET_INVALID, naming every problem, when a match is left out or set twice, a team is not one left in the round or plays twice, a team leaves its region, or a bye or linked winner is moved. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

put.summary: Set the winner of a play-in place
put.description: For a field row that stands for a play-in pairing ("Texas / Xavier"): the row then names the team that won, keeping its seed, tier, price and every pick of it, and the pairing's participant is inactivated. 404 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND for a row not on the event; 404 PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND when the winner is not an active participant of the event's sport; 409 PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_SPORT_LEAGUE when the event's sport league has a roster and the winner is not on it; 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_ALREADY_ON_FIELD when the winner already has a field row; 409 PLAY_IN_SLOT_ALREADY_PLAYED once the place has started or played a bracket match. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the field row. Root admin only.

put.summary: Replace a participant who withdrew after the draw
put.description: For a field row named in the bracket whose match has not started, before or after release: the replacement (a tennis lucky loser) gets its own field row in that bracket place, unseeded, last in the event's last tier and at its lowest price. The withdrawn row stays on the field, inactive as WITHDRAWN, keeping every pick of it, which scores as a first-round loss. 404 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND for a row not on the event; 404 PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND when the replacement is not an active participant of the event's sport; 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_IS_PLAY_IN_PLACE for a play-in place, which is filled instead; 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_BRACKET for a row no match names; 409 BRACKET_PARTICIPANT_ALREADY_PLAYED once its match has started; 409 BRACKET_PLACE_NOT_FIRST_ROUND for a place after the first round (a bye); 409 PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_SPORT_LEAGUE when the event's sport league has a roster and the replacement is not on it; 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_ALREADY_ON_FIELD when the replacement already has a field row. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the replacement's field row. Root admin only.

post.summary: Receive an SES delivery event from SNS
post.description: Public; called by Amazon SNS, never by the app. The message must come from this environment's SES events topic and carry a valid SNS signature from a certificate on the sns.<region>.amazonaws.com host of the topic's region, and be at most an hour old, or the answer is 403 EMAIL_EVENT_UNVERIFIED. A subscription confirmation is confirmed. A notification carries one SES event: a delivery marks the email DELIVERED; a permanent bounce marks it BOUNCED and a complaint COMPLAINED, and both stop the app from emailing that address again; a rejection marks it FAILED. A transient bounce changes nothing. An event for an email this environment did not send changes no email's status, though a permanent bounce or complaint still stops the app from emailing that address. Both still answer 200, so SNS does not retry them.

post.summary: Unsubscribe from one category of email by its link
post.description: Public; the token from an email's "Stop these emails" link or List-Unsubscribe header is its whole authority. It turns off the category of email the token names for the user it names, the same switch as on their account. Repeating it changes nothing. A token this app did not issue, or one for an account since deleted, is 400 EMAIL_UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_INVALID.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the email's unsubscribe link.

200.description: The category the unsubscribe link turned off.

get.summary: Get current selection state for a contest
get.description: Returns the current selection-room state for one event of the contest (#713): `sportEventId`, else its next event that has not started, else its last; 404 CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST for an event the contest does not cover. It includes the event's field, its picks, and each entry's status in it. A budget contest lists the whole field as one group, dearest first, and carries `lineupSummary`: the viewed entry's spend against the salary cap. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. A DRAFT contest answers 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND to anyone but its league's commissioners and root admins. Until the event's picks are revealed (the contest is live and the event has started, or a random draw has dealt) the pick history carries only the caller's own entries, and entryId selects another squad's entry only once they are; otherwise it falls back to the caller's own. 409 CONTEST_EVENT_REQUIRED for a contest that covers no event.

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: Specific contest entry to view within roster-based selection flows.

parameters.name: sportEventId
parameters.description: The contest event whose picks to show (#713). Defaults to the contest's next event that has not started, else its last event.

post.summary: Submit a pick
post.description: Submits a pick and returns the refreshed selection state for the pick's event: the event of the field row it names (#713). Picks are placed, swapped and unselected only while the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and that event's start time has not passed: 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise. In a budget contest re-selecting a held golfer unselects it, a golfer with no price is refused with 400 PRICE_MISSING, and the salary cap never refuses a pick: an entry may go over it while it rearranges. A change that leaves a SUBMITTED entry's lineup short, or over a budget contest's cap, sends the entry back to DRAFT; it must be submitted again to count.

200.description: Selection response returned immediately after a pick mutation.

post.summary: Submit a contest entry's picks for one event
post.description: Submits the caller's entry for one event of its contest (#713: "submit week 6", "submit your Masters picks") once that event's lineup is complete, and returns the refreshed selection state for that event. Each event of an entry starts as DRAFT and counts nowhere (leaderboard, standings, settlement, entry counts) until it is SUBMITTED. The lineup must hold the full roster with exactly each tier's picks: 409 ENTRY_LINEUP_INCOMPLETE otherwise. In a budget contest its picks must also cost no more than the salary cap: 409 ENTRY_OVER_BUDGET otherwise, reported only once the lineup is complete. Submitting an already submitted event changes nothing. A later pick change that leaves the lineup short or over the cap sends that event back to DRAFT. An event is submitted only while the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and that event's start time has not passed: 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST for an event the contest does not cover. Only a member of the entry's squad may submit it: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise.

get.summary: Get a prediction contest entry's game picks for one event
get.description: Returns one event's games, in game-number order and without cancelled games, with the entry's pick on each (#716). Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. The entry's own squad sees every pick; anyone else sees a pick only once its game is revealed, at that game's kickoff once the contest is live (in a bracket, every pick at the event's start). Each game carries the teams really playing it and the teams the entry's own picks put in it (`predictedHome`, `predictedAway`): in a bracket (#721) a later game offers the teams the entry picked to win the games before it, paired by seed in a reseeded round. A bracket's picks also carry their outcome (CORRECT, BUSTED or PENDING) and points, and the entry its points, the most it can still reach, and its tiebreaker. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

put.description: Saves the caller's picks on one event's games, all or none, and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Each pick names a game and the team picked to win, or in a pick'em pool whose sport offers it (`tiePicksOffered`) a tie (#792), and replaces the entry's pick on that game. In a bracket (#721) a pick must name a team the entry's picks put in the game (picks earlier in the same request count), and a later pick that no longer follows from them is cleared; the request may also set the event's `tiebreakerValue`, the total points of its tiebreaker game, a bracket's final or a week's last game (#717; 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED once that game's pick has locked). A bracket's every pick locks at the event's start. Only a member of the entry's squad may save: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. Refused with 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED unless the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE, and once the event's first game has started for a week still in draft (it doesn't count); 404 PREDICTION_GAME_NOT_FOUND for a game not in the event; 409 PREDICTION_GAME_STARTED once a game has kicked off; 400 PREDICTION_TEAM_NOT_IN_GAME for a team the game does not offer the entry; 400 PREDICTION_PICK_INVALID for a TEAM pick without its team or a TIE pick with one; 422 PREDICTION_TIE_NOT_OFFERED for a tie pick in a pool that takes none; 409 PREDICTION_CONFIDENCE_INVALID for a confidence value in a straight-up pool, outside 1 to the week's game count, or, after the first kickoff, leaving a submitted week's values repeated. A value may repeat until the week is submitted. Before the first kickoff, a change that leaves a submitted week's confidence values invalid sends it back to DRAFT. In a survivor contest (#719): 409 PREDICTION_ONE_PICK_REQUIRED unless the week holds exactly one pick; 409 PREDICTION_TEAM_ALREADY_USED for a team the entry picked in another submitted week; 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. On a playoff bracket (#785) each round is a week: the event is submitted once with its first round's one pick, each later round holds at most one pick (a new one replaces the entry's pick in that round), no team is picked in two rounds, and an entry out in one round picks no later round. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

delete.description: Removes the caller's pick on one game and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Clearing a game with no pick changes nothing. In a bracket the later picks that followed from it are cleared too (#721). Before the event's first kickoff, clearing a pick of a submitted week sends it back to DRAFT. Refused as saving is, and with 409 PREDICTION_CLEAR_AFTER_FIRST_KICKOFF once the first game has started: a submitted week then stays submitted, and a pick on a game still to start can be changed to the other team but not cleared. In a survivor contest (#719), 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

post.summary: Submit an entry's game picks for one event
post.description: Submits the caller's entry for one event ("submit week 6") and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Only a submitted event counts. Every game must be picked: 409 PREDICTION_WEEK_INCOMPLETE otherwise. In a confidence pool the values must be 1 to the game count, each used once: 409 PREDICTION_CONFIDENCE_INVALID otherwise. Every event needs its tiebreaker, a bracket's (#721) and a pick'em week's (#717): 409 PREDICTION_TIEBREAKER_MISSING otherwise. Submitting a submitted event changes nothing. Refused with 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED unless the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and the event's first game has not started. Only a member of the entry's team may submit: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. In a survivor contest (#719): 409 PREDICTION_ONE_PICK_REQUIRED unless the week holds exactly one pick; 409 PREDICTION_TEAM_ALREADY_USED for a team the entry picked in another submitted week; 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. On a playoff bracket (#785) each round is a week: the event is submitted once with its first round's one pick, each later round holds at most one pick (a new one replaces the entry's pick in that round), no team is picked in two rounds, and an entry out in one round picks no later round. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

post.summary: Run a random draw
post.description: Runs a random-draw contest's draw and returns the refreshed selection state. Commissioner of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 otherwise. The draw shuffles the event's available field and deals it round-robin, so every entry gets the contest's picksPerEntry; field members left over are not dealt. Every entry is submitted, entries close (no entering, leaving or renaming), and every entry's picks are visible to the league from then on. Final: there is no undo or redraw. The seed and dealt order are kept so the draw can be replayed. 409 CONTEST_NOT_RANDOM_DRAW for another selection type, CONTEST_DRAW_ALREADY_RUN once drawn, CONTEST_DRAW_NOT_OPEN unless the contest is OPEN, CONTEST_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED once its event's start time has passed, CONTEST_DRAW_NO_ENTRIES with no entries, CONTEST_DRAW_FIELD_TOO_SMALL when the available field cannot deal every entry its picks, CONTEST_DRAW_ENTRIES_CHANGED when an entry came or went while the draw ran (nothing is dealt; run it again).

get.description: The grid of a squares contest (#711): each claimed box and its entry, the digits once drawn, the game with its score at the end of each period and its final result, each scoring moment's winning box (frozen once the contest is Final), and each entry's boxes and wins. Any member of the contest's league may read it. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

put.summary: Claim a box of a squares grid
put.description: Claims an empty box for an entry and returns the grid. A member claims for their own squad's entry; the commissioner (or a root admin) for any entry: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND for an entry not in the contest. 409 SQUARES_CLAIMING_CLOSED unless the contest is OPEN, its numbers are not drawn and its game has not kicked off; SQUARES_BOX_TAKEN when someone holds the box; SQUARES_BOX_LIMIT_REACHED when the entry holds the contest's box limit. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

delete.summary: Clear a box of a squares grid
delete.description: Clears a claimed box and returns the grid. Its holder's squad may clear it, and the commissioner (or a root admin) any box: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 SQUARES_BOX_NOT_CLAIMED when nobody holds it. 409 SQUARES_CLAIMING_CLOSED under the same window as claiming. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

post.summary: Draw a squares contest's numbers
post.description: Draws the digits 0 to 9 along each side of the grid, at random, and returns the grid. Commissioner of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 otherwise. Claiming closes for good; every entry holding a box is submitted, and boxes nobody claimed stay empty. The seed is kept so the draw can be replayed. 409 SQUARES_ALREADY_DRAWN once drawn; SQUARES_DRAW_CLOSED unless the contest is OPEN or live and the game's first period score is not entered. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.
